notes:
CentraFlow 1.8.0 (build 17)

Chat repairs: real emoji reactions; the keyboard stays focused after sending; the next draft survives an in-flight send; swipe-to-reply moves a short distance and snaps back; compact quotes/reply previews and cleaner image-only messages.

Optional Android message notifications: enable Message notifications in Chat and grant the Android notification permission. Includes an audible high-importance Messages channel, conversation opening from an alert, a notification Reply action and manual retry for unsent quick replies. Notification text is retrieved through your signed-in account; the push transport carries routing IDs only. Existing local planner data and Google Classroom setup are preserved.

The protected Supabase dispatcher and private registration/retry queue are deployed. Live non-sending checks verified the Google sender credential, Vault-to-Edge authentication, private table access, function grants, active retry schedule and unsigned-request denial. No chat messages or phone alerts were generated by these checks.

Acceptance testing on both phones is still required: foreground/background/closed-app delivery, sound/pop-up, quick reply/retry, keyboard/gesture changes and logout/account-switch behavior. Android notification settings, DND, OEM battery restrictions and force-stop can delay or suppress alerts. Free-tier service limits apply. Chat remains restricted to the two approved test accounts. Phone acceptance is pending; this is not a finished public messenger or end-to-end encrypted service.

Install over the existing app; do not uninstall or clear app data. Package and signing certificate are unchanged. Both testers should update to build 17. This numbered release is available through Settings → App updates → Check for updates → Download update → Install. Android asks you to confirm installation.

Checks: the previous 132-test full suite passed; release metadata and updater checks passed again for this numbered build, with clean focused analysis; three local backend test cases passed with non-sending credential-probe assertions; release APK identity/certificate/Firebase configuration, Inter font/license and all 20 licensed FSL clips verified. No source or signing keys are published.
